L1-0186.note: Adv. 马上 L1-0226 owns "right away"; 就 is the sequencer, and 八岁就会 is "as early as".

L2-0064.note: N. 分数 L2-0166 owns "a score" and 结果 L2-0291 owns "result"; 成绩 is what was achieved.

L2-0214.note: Adv. 好大/好久 is degree. 这么 L2-0721 keeps "so or such"; 好 L1-0138 keeps "good".

L2-0286.note: V/Adv. 接下来 L2-0285 owns "next" and 那 L2-0387 owns "then"; 接着 is continuation.

L2-0431.note: N/V. 空气 L2-0327 owns "air". 煤气 is the gas sense, 喘气 the breath sense.

L3-0071.note: V. 采用 L3-0072 owns bare "to adopt"; 采取 collocates with 措施, 行动 and 态度.

L3-0148.note: N. 区 L3-0570 owns "district" and "zone"; 地区 is the larger territorial word.

L3-0164.note: V. 打破 L3-0125 owns "to break"; 断 breaks something long into two, as in 断了腿.

L3-0246.note: Adj. 共同 L3-0253 owns "shared"; 公共汽车 and 公共场所 are the open-to-all sense.

L3-0328.note: V. 过程 L3-0278 owns "a process"; 加工 is what a workshop does to raw material.

L3-0530.note: V. 比赛 L3-0039 owns "a match"; 这件衣服配这条裤子 is the goes-together sense.

L3-0877.note: V. 建 owns "to build", 制作 "to make", 制造 "to manufacture", 创造 "to create".

L4-0043.note: V/N. 符号 L4-0253 owns "symbol" and 牌 L4-0547 "signboard"; 标志 is the emblem.

L4-0193.note: V. 修理 L4-0828 owns "to fix"; 定时间 and 定计划 are the settle-on sense.

L4-0253.note: N. 标志 L4-0043 keeps the emblem sense; 符号 is what is written on a page.

L4-0327.note: Adj. 五颜六色 L4-0771 owns "multicolored"; 花衬衫 is patterned, 眼花 is blurred.

L4-0390.note: V. 降落 L4-0393 owns "to descend" and 降低 L4-0391 "to lower"; 降价, 降温.

L4-0495.note: N/V/M. 圆 L4-0913 owns "round" and 轮子 L4-0498 "wheel"; 第一轮 is this card.

L4-0547.note: N. 盘子 L4-0549 owns "a plate"; 标志/符号 own "sign"; 牌 is the board and the brand.

L4-0821.note: N. 类型 L4-0466 owns "type"; 血型, 新型, 型号 are all the model-of-a-thing sense.

L5-0061.note: Adj. 有害 L5-0926 owns "harmful"; 不良习惯 is undesirable, not actively harmful.

L5-0076.note: N. 餐馆 L5-0075 owns "restaurant"; 学生餐厅 is the room, not the business.

L5-0116.note: N/Adj. 劝 L5-0610 owns "to urge"; 冲动 is the impulse itself and acting on one.

L5-0178.note: N. 神经 L5-0669 owns "nerve"; 胆's figurative sense is courage, not the nervous system.

L5-0513.note: N. 模范 L5-0510 owns "model"; 工作模式 is the pattern something runs to.

L5-0606.note: N. 地带 L5-0195 owns "zone"; 区域 is the marked-out area, as in 服务区域.

L5-0681.note: Adj. 充足 L5-0118 owns "ample"; 十足的傻瓜 is the intensifier, not sufficiency.

L5-0710.note: N. 鼠 L5-0709 keeps "rat or mouse"; naming the device is what tells the two apart.
